crossRefs.note: One who brings gossip betrays a confidence, but one who is of a trustworthy spirit is one who keeps a secret.
The words of a gossip are like dainty morsels: they go down into a person’s innermost parts.
For lack of wood a fire goes out. Without gossip, a quarrel dies down.
“ ‘You shall not go around as a slanderer among your people. “ ‘You shall not endanger the life of your neighbor. I am…
My son, fear Yahweh and the king. Don’t join those who are rebellious;
A man of violence entices his neighbor, and leads him in a way that is not good.
For those who are such don’t serve our Lord, Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering…

translations.web: He who goes about as a tale-bearer reveals secrets; therefore don’t keep company with him who opens wide his lips.
translations.bsb: He who reveals secrets is a constant gossip; avoid the one who babbles with his lips.
translations.kjv: He that goeth about as a talebearer revealeth secrets: therefore meddle not with him that flattereth with his lips.
translations.asv: He that goeth about as a tale-bearer revealeth secrets; Therefore company not with him that openeth wide his lips.
